title: Sung J, Melodii Rozet - I Miss You

lines.l: I miss your touch, I miss your kiss, I miss your love, I miss you
I touch my skin, kiss my lips, held me tight, squeeze my hips, let me down
The other man did, heard a knock at the door, looked over my shoulder
Saw my lover staring at me
Shook his head, walked away
Didn't have words to say
I can't believe it
I didn't mean it
I begged and pleaded, pleaded
But he didn't listen
I miss you, I miss you, I miss you, I miss you
Come back to me
I miss you, I miss you, I miss you, I miss you
Come back to me
I opened up my eyes and he wasn't there
Now I'm feeling lonely and now I'm getting scared
Where did he go? Tell me where it went
I'm looking for him and I can't find him
He coming back, homes back to my arms where he belongs again
I'm sending out an SOS to find him
I cheated on him and I feel so bad I can't take it back
I begged and pleaded and he won't cut me any slack
I know I'm not perfect, yes, I make my mistakes
But I would change my ways if you'd just tell me you would stay
I miss you, I miss you, I miss you, I miss you
Come back to me
I miss you, I miss you, I miss you, I miss you
And your life, the love that I gave you made you feel so right
You did me so wrong, tried so hard to hold on to what we had
Part of me said let go, part of me still don't know
What to do when it comes to our love
I crossed the line, in deepest sight
I'll admit, I'll regret it
It wasn't worth it for losing you
For the careless things I do
I miss you, I miss you, I miss you, I miss you
Come back to me
I miss you, I miss you, I miss you
Come back to me
I miss you, I miss you, I miss you, I miss you
